articles.summary: Appomattox Regional Governor’s School Wins 5th Sheflett Memorial STEM Challenge RICHMOND, V.a. — Appomattox Regional Governor’s School earned first place in the fifth annual Sheflett Memorial STEM Challenge, presented by Primis Bank, with each student team member receiving a $500 scholarship for their innovative use of artificial intelligence to solve a real-world banking challenge. Chesapeake
articles.title: Appomattox Regional Governor’s School Wins 5th Sheflett Memorial STEM Challenge - Primis Bank
